simulate_quantize_array: simulate quantization on a JAX array using INT4, INT8, Q4_0, or SFP8 methods for quantization aware training
build_simulate_quantized_dense: build a Flax SimulateQuantizedDense module that wraps nn.Dense with simulated quantization on the kernel weights
build_simulate_quantized_einsum: build a Flax SimulateQuantizedEinsum module that wraps nn.Einsum with simulated quantization on the kernel weights
build_int_dense: build a Flax IntDense module that stores kernel weights as int4 with a learnable scale parameter
get_axis_to_reduce_from_einsum: get the axis to reduce from an einsum string like BTD,NDH->BTNH for quantization purposes
